answers.core: The first solution extends the ResourceLoader and -Saver singletons, the second requires changes to GDExtension. Both are core changes.
answers.workaround: It might be possible to create global ResourceFormatLoaders and -Savers with GDScript that forward method calls to their GDExtension counterparts.

title: Allow adding custom ResourceFormatLoaders and ResourceFormatSavers with GDExtension
